about: The one declaration of the frames a cut is rendered in. render.mjs takes FORMAT=<id>; reel.html lays every scene out for the frame (window.FRAME); site/build.mjs encodes each at `web` and the page serves the format whose `media` matches the viewer. `detail` is the tier: an element marked data-detail="n" appears only where detail >= n. `safe` is the frame the layout gate keeps a scene's ink inside, as insets from the left, top, right and bottom edges (the brand, the chapter and the rail of acts sit outside it).
